tool_input.command: perl -0pi -e 's/\n  --space-1: var\(--space-4\);.*?--space-8: var\(--space-32\);//s; my %m=(1=>4,2=>8,3=>12,4=>16,6=>24,8=>32); s/var\(--space-([123468])\)/"var(--space-".$m{$1}.")"/ge; s/var\(--color-status-(active|paused|done)-(bg|text)\)/var(--color-surface-raised)/g if 0;' src/styles/base.css && grep -n "space-\|status-" src/styles/base.css | head -20
tool_input.description: Remap legacy spacing variables to token names
